# The issue's CE short link (73so7qzzW, resolved via api/shortlinkinfo) records
# "-fspv-target-env=universal1.5", but no "-spirv" flag, so the compile still
# targets DXIL, not SPIR-V -- the reported "add i32 ..., -2" text is DXIL/LLVM
# IR, matching the issue body. A byte-for-byte control (with vs. without
# -fspv-target-env, otherwise identical) confirms the flag is inert here and
# is dropped for clarity; cmd-as-filed.txt preserves the original.
#
# Profile lowered from the reporter's "ps_6_7" to "ps_6_0": the defect is an
# AST/CodeGen-level inout-parameter bug with no dependency on shader-model
# version, and ps_6_7 does not exist before v1.7.2207, which would otherwise
# make every earlier release an unprobeable invalid-probe (SKILL.md step 6
# "target the repro at the oldest profile ... that still shows the symptom").
# variant-as-filed-ps67-main-debug.txt is a control proving ps_6_0 and ps_6_7
# produce the identical "-2" defect, so lowering the profile changes nothing
# about what is being measured.
-T ps_6_0 -E PSMain -Zi -Qembed_debug repro.hlsl
